decisions.rationale: C2B-PIN: the Selected input and identity section defines future explicit repository/revision/provider/source binding. The pinned worksheet witnesses existing C1 collection only. No production source or qualifier implementation changes; this obligation is a proposed contract for the next slice, not a claim of source authenticity.

C2B-CHANNEL: the Channel decision table defines qualified/unqualified/unknown and bounds static pytest selectors to exact direct function declarations. C1 resolver facts inform the design; no new production caller applies this classification yet. Contract-only scope preserves the distinction between a proposed eligibility rule and an implemented Specification.

C2B-ATOM: the Atom decision section orders uncontested good, unknown and conclusive-negative alternatives and specifies counting once. The 16 acceptance examples propose future regression cases. No runtime aggregation or decision table is introduced in this PR.

C2B-COMPUTE: the Exact result table specifies complete zero, empty and incomplete states plus nullable exact values. The 13/13 worksheet is explicitly author-expected reference data, not a runtime SVC evaluator or migration of legacy scoring. Production source and activation remain unchanged.

C2B-CONFLICT: the repeated-observation section specifies source membership agreement, provenance-preserving coalescing and unknown conflicts. Existing C1 facts are inspected but no production conflict consumer changes. The new semantics remain a reviewable profile contract requiring future implementation tests.

C2B-SEPARATION: the Execution and revision section prohibits transferring PB results to unobserved PE channels or treating resolution as tests_verified, fulfillment or admission. Proposal/DocC/tracking identify the evaluator as not implemented and retain disabled activation. No execution-report evaluator, metric registry default, viewer or CI behavior changes.
